Old names kept for rmoriedata 0.3.x

Source: R/compat_0_5.R
rmbl-compat.Rd

rmoriedata 0.3.x on CRAN calls eleven functions by their 0.5.x names. These wrappers keep that release installing and checking against rmoriebricklayer 1.0.0. Each one forwards to the function named in its body, translating the old argument names; new code should call the new names directly, and these wrappers go when every released rmoriedata uses them.

Usage

capsule_sign(
  message,
  key,
  scheme = NULL,
  context = NULL,
  deterministic = FALSE,
  prehash = "none",
  masked = getOption("rmoriebricklayer.masked", TRUE)
)

capsule_verify(message, signature, key, context = NULL, prehash = NULL)

pqc_keygen(height = 10L, sk_seed = NULL, pub_seed = NULL, sk_prf = NULL)

signing_public_key(key)

core_sha256(x)

core_mean(x)

sha256_file(path)

bricklayer_json_to_json(x, ...)

bricklayer_json_from_json(txt, ...)

bricklayer_fetch(url, dest, wayback = "", timeout = 120L)

wayback_snapshot_url(url, timestamp = NULL)

Arguments

message, signature, key, scheme, context, deterministic, prehash, masked

As msg, sig, key, scheme, ctx, determ, prehash and masked of cpssign() and cpsvrf().

height, sk_seed, pub_seed, sk_prf

As height, skseed, pubseed and skprf of pqckg().

x, path, txt, ...

Passed through to csha256(), cmn(), sha256file(), tojs() and fromjs().

url, dest, wayback, timeout

As url, dest, wb and tmout of blfetch().

timestamp

As ts of wbsnpurl().

Value

What the forwarded function returns.

Examples

k <- pqc_keygen(height = 2)
s <- capsule_sign(core_sha256("manifest"), k)
capsule_verify(core_sha256("manifest"), s, signing_public_key(k))
#> [1] TRUE
